per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Linked DBAASP assay rows were matched to primary Table 1 values where possible. CAMP/dbAMP entry-text rows and Xanthomonas nomenclature differences remain source_conflict cautions rather than being normalized away.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is accepted as computational/design context and structure-activity association only; no direct antimicrobial membrane-assay mechanism is overclaimed for the new analogues.
per_layer_decision_rationale.review: The previous blocking issue was a framework/test limitation, not an unrecoverable material gap. Local XML/PDF/database surfaces were enough for obtainable-only repair with cautions.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Several linked database rows use broader entry-level annotations, older/synonym pathogen names, or no local linked sequence snapshot; these remain source_conflict records with primary Table 1 matches where possible.
The paper reports MD/design rationale and MIC activity but not direct antimicrobial membrane mechanism assays for every new analogue.
Packet/source inventory and PMC metadata show no supplementary assets; no unsupported supplement values were fabricated.
